subject: tech
title: Find the Bug
about: A bug is a mistake in the steps, and debugging means finding it and fixing it, then trying again (K2-AP-07, K2-AP-08). The cards show a robot that put socks on after shoes, a square drawn with three sides and a pattern with one wrong spot, and ask which step to fix. Read it together and keep it light: everyone makes bugs, and computers never get mad about them.
tip: When something he builds or draws goes wrong, say 'I think there is a bug, let's find it' instead of 'that's wrong', then check one step at a time together.

cards.q: A mistake in the steps has a funny name. What is it called?
cards.note: A bug is a mistake in the steps. Long ago, people even found a real moth stuck inside a big computer!

cards.q: Finding a bug and fixing it has a name too. What is it?
cards.note: De-bugging means taking the bug out. Find it, fix it, try again.

cards.q: A robot put on shoes, then socks. Which step should come first?
cards.note: The bug is the order. Fix: socks first, then shoes, then try again.

cards.q: A drawing program drew a square with 3 sides. What is the fix?
cards.note: A square has 4 sides. The steps said 3, so change the number to 4 and run it again.

cards.q: The steps say: draw a side, turn, draw a side, turn, draw a side. What is missing?
cards.note: Check one step at a time and count. Three sides drawn, one still missing.

cards.q: You found the bug and fixed it. What do you do next?
cards.note: Fix, then test. Trying again shows if the fix worked.

cards.q: You made a bug. What does the computer do?
cards.note: A computer never gets mad. It just waits for you to find and fix the bug.

cards.q: Everyone who writes steps makes bugs sometimes. Is a bug a bad thing or a normal thing?
cards.note: Bugs happen to everyone, even grown-ups who make games. Finding one is part of the job.

cards.q: Your steps went wrong somewhere. What is the best way to find the bug?
cards.note: Go step by step: did step 1 work? Did step 2? The bug is hiding in one of them.

cards.q: 🔴 🔵 🔴 🔴 🔴 🔵 This pattern has a bug. Which spot is wrong?
cards.sayQ: A pattern: red, blue, red, red, red, blue. This pattern has a bug. Which spot is wrong?
cards.note: Red, blue, red, blue is the pattern. The fourth spot should be blue, not red.

cards.q: 🔴 🔵 🔴 🔴 🔴 🔵 What should the fourth spot be?
cards.sayQ: A pattern: red, blue, red, red, red, blue. What should the fourth spot be?
cards.note: After red comes blue. Swap the fourth spot to blue and the pattern is fixed.

cards.sayQ: A pattern: star, moon, star, moon, moon, moon. Which spot is the bug?
cards.note: Star, moon, star, moon... the fifth spot should be a star.

cards.q: Your block tower falls. The steps said: big block on top. Which step is the bug?
cards.note: Big blocks go on the bottom. Move the big block down and build again.

cards.q: Steps for cereal: get a bowl, pour milk, eat. What step is missing?
cards.note: A missing step is a bug too. You cannot eat cereal that is not in the bowl!

cards.q: A bug in a game makes your car drive backwards. What do the game makers do?
cards.note: Even grown-ups who make games have bugs. They debug, test, and share the fix.

cards.q: You fixed a bug. A friend asks how you did it. What is a good answer?
cards.note: Telling how you found and fixed a bug helps you and your friend next time.

cards.q: You tried a fix and it is still broken. What now?
cards.note: Sometimes there is more than one bug. Keep checking, one step at a time.
